row:
What does it take to work in sports medicine and orthopedics — and what does each career pay?

In this episode of Future You, we break down three real careers built around the human body: Athletic Trainer, Physical Therapist, and Orthopedic Surgeon. See a day in the life for each one, the exact high school steps to take now, and real salary numbers from entry-level to the top.

Made for teens 13+ exploring their future, and parents looking for an honest way to help them do it. No fluff — just what the job is, what it pays, and how to get there.

In this episode:
- Athletic Trainer
- Physical Therapist
- Orthopedic Surgeon
- A free career guide PDF

New episodes weekly — subscribe so you don't miss the next one.

Comment: which career surprised you most or what you would like to see in a future episode.

Free PDF: https://ln5.sync.com/dl/2779af310#iyr5ujrq-efm55mr3-36xdgx7m-69pyqqh3
